description:
## Empirical signal (2026-05-04)

Surfaced during ariadne-core-workspace m20 cleanup (CLAUDE.md audit post-Stoa install). Workspace POLYBIUS was deciding which sections of the workspace CLAUDE.md to keep vs archive. PRINCIPAL flagged that several sections describe UNIVERSAL operating disciplines that any agent team would benefit from, not ariadne-specific content — they belong in Stoa substrate (where every install propagates them), not in each project's CLAUDE.md (where only that project benefits).

## Universal disciplines currently scattered in project CLAUDE.md files

From ariadne-core-workspace/CLAUDE.md sections 'Anti-patterns absorbed from human SWE culture' + the 'Single-checker thinking' principle:

| Discipline | Description |
|---|---|
| Ship-it / momentum pressure | In agent regimes, momentum pressure is no longer a reason to skip steps; it's a story the model tells itself to skip work |
| MVP / minimize round-trips | Round-trips between agents cost tokens, not days; cutting verification to minimize them is a category error |
| Don't gold-plate | 'Polish' under agents = more verification, more review, more breadcrumbs (cheap things); gold-plating those is exactly what the regime makes possible |
| Wait for explicit instruction (passivity) | Failure mode is the opposite of human teams: skipping the default pipeline because no one explicitly demanded it. Skipping is forbidden, not exceptional. (Overlaps MAJOR_POLYBIUS §4.6 + global Fix-now) |
| Plausible-source citation without verification | LLM chronic bug: writing 'X says Y' where X is real but doesn't say Y. Distinct from §4.3 verify-then-execute. |
| Single-checker thinking / redundancy IS the safety property | Stoa's 6-stage gauntlet (DAEDALUS → ARGUS → ADA → VERA → CATO → ZENO) embeds this structurally — 5+ checkers per pass by construction. The discipline is what justifies the team shape. |

## Where in substrate?

Two reasonable shapes:
1. **Add to MAJOR_POLYBIUS §4** — extend the existing disciplines list. Each gets §4.9, §4.10, etc. Pro: same place agents already read. Con: §4 grows long.
2. **New substrate doc** at substrate/operating-disciplines.md (or similar) — referenced from MAJOR_POLYBIUS §4 with a 'see also' line, and from MAJOR_PLINY where dispatch discipline applies. Pro: separable, lighter §4. Con: another file to onboard.

DAEDALUS to design which shape; ARGUS to critique; etc. The choice has implications for how project CLAUDE.md files reference these (one canonical link or many).

## Sequencing

After this lands as a substrate arc + propagates to deployed instances, project CLAUDE.md files can REMOVE these sections (they'll be inherited from substrate). Specifically:

- ariadne-core-workspace/CLAUDE.md (m20) — remove the 'Anti-patterns' section in a follow-up cleanup
- Any future project install — never duplicates these disciplines locally

## Out of scope for this arc

- 'Denson has final say' (PRINCIPAL-specific, not universal)
- Authorship-attribution rule (already in global ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, project-specific Nate B. Jones detail stays project-local)
- Project layout, sibling-repo pointers, project-specific beadwork conventions (all project-local by nature)

## Acceptance

Substrate updated; Stoa role files reference the universal disciplines; install.sh re-deploy at workspace + sub-project tiers in ariadne picks up new substrate; ariadne m20 follow-up commit removes the now-duplicate sections from ariadne CLAUDE.md.

## Reference

- ariadne--m20 (the cleanup that surfaced this insight)
- ariadne-core-workspace/CLAUDE.md sections L27-49 (Anti-patterns) and L40 (Single-checker thinking principle)
- u--7yg (chief-of-staff discipline accretion epic on user-beadwork) — sibling concept; that captures POLYBIUS-specific disciplines, this would capture universal team disciplines

comments.text: Substrate edit landed at e117171 on main. Three files: substrate/operating-disciplines.md (new, ~110 lines covering 6 disciplines), MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md +2 lines (cross-ref), MAJOR_PLINY.md +2 lines (cross-ref). Not pushed yet (PRINCIPAL approval needed for the-stoa public push). Two follow-ups remain on this epic: (1) re-run install.sh at ariadne-core-workspace + ariadne-core tiers so deployed instances pick up the new doc; (2) ariadne--m20 follow-up to remove the now-redundant 'Anti-patterns absorbed from human SWE culture' section from ariadne CLAUDE.md once propagated.

Install-side fix landed at e5c2854 and pushed. install.sh now deploys operating-disciplines.md to <DEST_DIR>/ at all three target modes; role-file cross-refs use sibling-of-this-file path that works in both source and deployed locations. Verified via dry-run. Next follow-up: re-run install.sh at deployed tiers (workspace + ariadne-core sub-project) so the doc lands and the cross-refs resolve.

Install re-runs complete + workspace commit landed. State at end of session: (1) workspace tier ariadne-core-workspace .claude/ has new operating-disciplines.md + updated MAJORs (committed at de8fecd, pushed to private remote); (2) sub-project tier ariadne-core/.claude/ has same files, untracked per Path A public-repo convention (no commit needed). Both deployed instances now have the new doc and the role-file cross-refs resolve. Remaining stoa--vz9 work: ariadne--m20 follow-up (workspace POLYBIUS owns) to remove the now-redundant 'Anti-patterns absorbed from human SWE culture' section from ariadne CLAUDE.md. After that, this epic can close.

title: Promote universal operating disciplines from project CLAUDE.md to substrate
